title: Create a custom script

writePrompt:
Write text for a custom script of a code editor, from what the person filled in below. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, without a code block. The keys of the object are: {keys}. The key "name" is a short name of at most five words, starting with a verb, without a final period. The key "description" is one to three short sentences. Here is what the person filled in:

{description}

badAnswer: The coding agent did not answer in the expected form. Try again.
